tools.name: gauntlet_validate_opportunity
tools.description: Validate a supplied opportunity using native rules. A native validation failure remains ok=false, not a successful opportunity. No browser or external action.

tools.name: gauntlet_next_mission
tools.description: Retrieve the native next mission from the current generated control-plane data. Does not execute it, certify current external eligibility, or grant submission authority.

tools.name: gauntlet_mission
tools.description: Retrieve one registered route's existing browser mission and protected gates. No submission, attestation, arbitrary URL navigation or checkpoint mutation.
